reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East

description.narrative: UNRWA will continue strengthening its protection response through protection monitoring and expanded case management across emergency shelters and community settings, aiming to reach over 100,000 people with protection and social services. The Agency will reinforce referral pathways for GBV survivors, unaccompanied and separated children and other at-risk individuals, linking them to specialised services including PSS, legal aid and safe spaces, and will prioritise community-based PSS and psychological first aid activities. UNRWA will also provide cash-for-protection to 10,000 individuals at high or critical risk, including released detainees, unaccompanied and separated children and orphans, and support persons with disabilities through assistive devices, referrals and inclusive activities. In coordination with humanitarian partners, the Agency will deliver explosive ordnance risk education to over 200,000 children and adults and continue to mainstream protection across its health, education, shelter and WASH programmes.
